title: Safe Guard: an LLM-agent for Real-time Voice-based Hate Speech Detection in Social Virtual Reality
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation and performance evaluation (accuracy, latency, and false positive reduction) of a hate speech detection system. While hate speech detection is a safety and moderation task, and definitions of hate speech include categories like religion, the research does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
